paragraphs: The X3's diesel range has been a cornerstone of BMW's SUV line-up for years. Under the G01 generation (2017–2024), the xDrive20d and xDrive30d use two distinct B-series engines: the B47 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder in the xDrive20d — and the B57 — a 3.0-litre six-cylinder in the xDrive30d. Both are part of BMW's modern diesel family, designed for efficiency and durability. The X3 was fully redesigned for model year 2025 (the G45 generation), and while petrol variants have confirmed updated powertrain names, the exact diesel badge structure for the new generation has not yet been independently confirmed. The xDrive20d and xDrive30d remained in production through the G01 run, and we continue to rebuild engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 xDrive30d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the xDrive20d from 2017 to 2024 (G01 generation). A modern, efficient diesel engine from BMW's B-series family. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B47 rebuild.

A 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel fitted to the xDrive30d from 2017 to 2024 (G01 generation). A larger, more powerful diesel engine from the same B-series family. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B57 rebuild.
